shortDescription: Iranian negotiators met Qatari mediators in Doha for a third consecutive day, seeking an agreement to end the U.S.-Iran war. According to ChainCatcher, an official familiar with the talks told Reuters that the discussions aimed to advance such an agreement.

title: Iranian Negotiators Meet Qatari Mediators for Third Day to Advance U.S.-Iran Deal
